title: WARRANT OpenSpec workflow schema source
description: Source of `openspec/schemas/<name>/schema.yaml`: the artifact dependency graph of an OpenSpec workflow (ADR-0015 point 4). Every `requires` entry MUST name an artifact declared in the same file.

name.description: Schema name as OpenSpec resolves it, for example `warrant-sdd`.

version.description: Schema version as an integer, incremented on every incompatible change.

description.description: What this workflow is for, in one sentence.

artifacts.description: Artifacts of the workflow, in dependency order.

id.description: Artifact id, referenced by `requires` and by the `rules` keys.

generates.description: Path the artifact generates inside the change directory, for example `proposal.md`.

description.description: What this artifact contains, in one sentence.

template.description: Template file relative to the schema `templates/` directory.

instruction.description: Instruction given to the agent producing this artifact.

requires.description: Artifact ids that must be complete before this artifact is produced.

apply.description: How implementation of a Change is tracked once planning is complete.

requires.description: Artifact ids that must be complete before implementation may start.

tracks.description: File whose checkboxes track implementation progress, for example `tasks.md`.

instruction.description: Instruction given to the agent during implementation.
